abstract_research_topics.justification: Decision theory is an abstract research topic focusing on the principles and models for decision-making in complex environments, often involving probabilistic outcomes.
Optimal control theory deals with mathematical optimization methods for achieving the best results in dynamic systems, which are more theoretical and abstract in nature.
Control systems study the mathematical and theoretical aspects of designing systems to maintain desired outputs, making it an abstract research topic.
Policy and governance as a domain explores frameworks and theories for implementing policies, which aligns more with theoretical investigations rather than specific applications of Deep Learning.
Control algorithms involve developing mathematical models and algorithms for managing control systems, which is an abstract research topic.
This involves the development of frameworks and theoretical approaches for making decisions collaboratively, making it an abstract research topic.
This domain focuses on theoretical frameworks for decision-making involving multiple criteria, which is more abstract.
Robust control is an area focusing on control systems that function under uncertainties by relying on theoretical models and analyses.
This involves creating learning methods for continuous control tasks, concentrating on theoretical advancements.
A theoretical focus on control strategies within discrete systems in mathematics and computer science contexts.
Focuses on the theoretical aspects of making decisions, often involving statistical and algorithmic methods.

application_domains.justification: Bipedal robotics is a practical application domain focused on building robots that walk on two legs, applying Deep Learning to real-world robotic systems.
Robotics is broadly an application domain where Deep Learning techniques are implemented to enable intelligent autonomous behaviors.
This is an application domain where Deep Learning is used in robots to enhance photographic capabilities.
A technique applied in machine learning models to improve decision-making processes by combining various policies, fitting it as an application domain.
Involves the implementation of methods to evaluate policies, which is an application of learned models rather than theoretical development.
Focuses on building and managing robots that resemble and mimic human actions, an application domain for Deep Learning.
Typically refers to the application of robotics principles to real-world use cases using Deep Learning.
Application domain leveraging Deep Learning technologies for photography through robotic systems.
Involves applying theories in real-world scenarios for managing policies, making it more of an application domain when applied.
A practical application domain related to implementing Deep Learning in systems tasked with managing directional outputs.
An application domain focusing on developing robots with limbs (like legs) for movement, often employing Deep Learning.
Similar to bipedal robotics, a practical application domain for creating and enhancing two-legged robotics using Deep Learning.
A broad application domain encompassing systems where robotics principles and Deep Learning methods are implemented.
Focuses on the practical collaborative exploration tasks, often approached with Deep Learning algorithms in realistic settings.
